jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer - Dashboards
jobs_results.description:
The Dashboards team builds, scales and operates high-performance, programmable, and beautiful user interfaces, where customers get to visualize and explore data about their systems. They solve complex and challenging issues around user experience. The team is responsible for UI, API and storage using React, Javascript, Python and Postgres.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:
• Own meaningful parts of our user interfaces, with an eye for performance and user experience
• Implement compelling, usable UIs, contribute to their design and engineer them with React
• Participate or lead architectural decisions for new and existing features
• Collaborate with experienced peers who will lift you up and be a mentor to other engineers on your... team
• Join a tightly knit team solving hard problems the right way

Who You Are:
• You have been building applications for 4+ years and know the systems you’ve worked on from top to bottom
• You have significant programming experience on the frontend (with a preference for the React environment)
• You have already made product decisions that shaped the day-to-day life of your users
• You want to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment that values diversity of talent, excellence of product, and exciting engineering challenges at scale

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:
• Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
• Continuous career development and pathing opportunities for internal mobility
• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking
• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds
• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
• Free global mental health benefit through Spring Health
• Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

About Datadog:

Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) is a global SaaS business, delivering a rare combination of growth and profitability. We are on a mission to break down silos and solve complexity in the cloud age by enabling digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers’ entire technology stacks. Built by engineers, for engineers, Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. Together, we champion professional development, diversity of thought, innovation, and work excellence to empower continuous growth. Join the pack and become part of a collaborative, pragmatic, and thoughtful people-first community where we solve tough problems, take smart risks, and celebrate one another. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Equal Opportunity at Datadog:

Datadog is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog’s Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice

jobs_results.title: iOS Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Desde Marlex Human Capital estamos colaborando con una consultora multinacional de desarrollo de software con más de 30 años en el sector y presencia internacional en 42 países. Actualmente se encuentran en la búsqueda de un/a iOS Software Engineer para unirse a su equipo de desarrolladores en Barcelona.

Colaborarás junto al equipo de Development y Solutions, conformado por desarrolladores Android y Web. Te encargarás de toda la arquitectura, programación y desarrollo de la parte iOS del proyecto. Y las tecnologías con las que trabajarás son: Objective-C, Swift, Git, GitFlow, JSON y Jenkins.

Ofrecen un contrato indefinido directamente con la empresa y un salario de hasta 70.000 euros brutos anuales en función de la experiencia. Tienen un horario flexible y muy buen ambiente laboral.

Requirements:
• Experiencia: Más de 2 años como iOS Software Engineer
• Dominar Objective-C
• SBA: Hasta 70.000 euros brutos anuales, segun experiencia aportada.
• Horario: De 9-12h y de 14-16h, pero... hay flexibilidad.
• Idiomas: Inglés nivel mínimo B2.
• Teletrabajo: Puntualmente, valoran la presencialidad

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer (Data Services)
jobs_results.description:
The team

The Engineering team at Vonage is a fast growing group of talented engineers. They face multiple challenges associated with high performance, distributed systems, and processing large volumes of data in real time.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join a team dedicated to transforming the data pipeline to a real-time event-driven one. The team has numerous data related exciting initiatives in the works, with ample opportunities to make your own mark.

The role
• Design & build systems to process and analyze tens of millions of daily events
• Real-time data processing using stream technologies (Kafka streaming or similar)
• Work with big data technologies
• Write efficient and scalable code
• Develop on a public cloud infrastructure

The Stack
• AWS (RDS, S3, EMR, ...)
• Google Cloud (BigQuery, GDS)
• Kafka
• Java (somePython)
• Docker, Kubernetes
• Anything needed to achieve our goals

Must Have
• Strong software engineering skills with interest in data.
• Java
•... SQL / NoSQL
• Experience dealing with event-driven pipeline (Kafka or other).
• Willingness to learn and use new technology/programming language.

Nice To Have
• Experience with streaming framework
• Experience with open source OLAP system (Druid, Pinot…)
• Telecommunication knowledge
• Docker and Kubernetes exposure
• Experience with public cloud
• Python

Why Vonage

We value disruptive innovation, getting things done, and working with passion and integrity are the values that matter at Nexmo. We are on a mission to enable simplified communications between enterprises and their customers by empowering our employees. We strive for passion and integrity, both personally and professionally.

We have achieved significant growth by hiring exceptional people. We have big goals, and we want the people who join us to be self-confident, focused on customers and delivery, and who are structured and committed in their approach. jobs_results.title: Desarrollador de software
jobs_results.description:
En un mundo que cambia rápidamente, se necesita un espíritu pionero para crear tecnología fiable. Hacemos posible la conectividad segura para miles de millones de personas en todo el mundo. En Giesecke+Devrient, desempeñará un papel clave en la realización de la transformación digital. En G+D Mobile Security buscamos un Ingeniero de Desarrollo de Software Senior para el Departamento de IT Solutions donde desarrollamos aplicaciones informáticas destinadas aimplementar soluciones a la compañía (world wide) dentro de nuestro departamento IT, para aportar valor añadido a las necesidades de todos los departamentos. Te integrarás en un equipo de 10 desarrolladores, en una estructura plana liderada por la responsable de Desarrollo de Soluciones, donde bajo metodología scrum podrás participar enlos diferentes pasos del proceso y responsabilizarte de uno o dos proyectos como Tech Lead: toma de requisitos, arquitectura, definición, desarrollo, test, evolutivos y mantenimiento.

Tu día a día en... G+D:
• Desarrollar componentes de software trabajando con las últimas tecnologías y lenguajes dentro del framework .NET C#.
• .NET Framework 4.7.
• Entity framework para conectar el back con el SQL Server.
• Front: ASP.NET, HTML5, CSS3, JS, JQuery y Bootstrap.
• Mejorar no sólo tu propio proceso de trabajo, sino el del equipo, sugiriendo las mejores prácticas, nuevas tecnologías y renovando las existentes.
• Liderar desarrollos propios proponiendo las mejores ideas para ser seguido por el equipo en tecnologías y procesos de desarrollo.
• Crear soluciones y construir los mejores proyectos posibles muy cerca del cliente interno para obtener resultados excelentes.
• Entregar software funcional y testeado cada tres semanas, usando metodología Scrum.

Qué buscamos en ti:
• Titulado universitario medio o superior (preferiblemente en informática).
• Experiencia en ASP.Net (mínimo 4 años).
• Experiencia con Framework 4.0 o superior de .NET
• Conocimientos de Rest APIs, SQL Server.
• Jugador de equipo: estás abierto a discusiones sin ego.
• Nivel alto de inglés para proyectos internacionales. (se puede realizar prueba)

Se valorará:
• Conocimientos en otras tecnologías web.Net, especialmente Blazor.
• Experiencia en .Net Core o .Net 5 o superior.
• Experiencia en Azure DevOps (CI/CD).
• Desarrollo de aplicaciones en plataformas móviles.
• Business Intelligence en Microsoft SQL Server.
• Gestión de proyectos (PMI), SCRUM, Usabilidad, Lean IT.
• Capacidad de liderazgo, motivación por nuevos retos y con ganas de aprender.

Beneficios:
• CULTURA: únete a un entorno activo y profesional, dónde el buen ambiente, trabajo en equipo y teambuilding son esenciales.
• FILOSOFÍA: estarás en un equipo con talento donde todo el mundo tiene voz para aportar nuevas ideas y mejoras ¡siéntete involucrado/a en G+D!
• HORARIO: L-J 8.30-17.30h , V 8.30-15.30h (con 1 hora de flexibilidad de entrada, la conciliación es importante para nosotros). Teletrabajo el 80% del tiempo.
• CONTRATO Y BENEFICIOS SOCIALES: contrato indefinido, plan de formación anual, mutua privada, parking de empresa, jornada intensiva de verano, retribución flexible (ticket transporte, ticket guardería, formación), etc.
• CANTINA / COMEDOR DE EMPRESA: espacio diáfano, con servicio de desayuno y comidas propio. (Precios subvencionados).
• UBICACIÓN: estamos ubicados en El Prat de Llobregat, salida autopista Mercabarna. Accesible en transporte público Bus 88 y 110 desde Barcelona y PR4 desde el Prat, Metro L10S, parada ZAL/Riu Vell

jobs_results.title: INGENIERO DE VERIFICACION Y VALIDACIÒN DE SOFTWARE
jobs_results.description:
Indra es una de las principales compañías globales de tecnología y consultoría y el socio tecnológico para las operaciones clave de los negocios de sus clientes en todo el mundo. Desde Indra asumimos el reto de diseñar e implantar tecnologías que ayuden a resolver los desafíos de nuestra sociedad en materia social y ambiental.

¿Qué estamos buscando?
• Un Ingeniero de pruebas de validación dentro de Ingeniería y Tecnología
• Coordinar y revisar los trabajos de planificación y ejecución del V&V de SW
• Desarrollar y escribir procedimientos operativos estándar para nuevos procesos y equipos.
• Responsable de proporcionar liderazgo a los contratistas que apoyan el programa de Validación.
• Revisar y escribir protocolos de validación, informes finales y resúmenes de trabajo
• Proporcionar liderazgo y orientación al personal de validación y contratistas participantes

• Incorporarte a una... compañía con más de 40.000 profesionales y con acceso a proyectos retadores para clientes líderes en sus sectores de actividad.

• Programas que promueven el desarrollo profesional de las mujeres y la adecuada integración de las personas con discapacidad.

jobs_results.title: Elite Software Engineering Program
jobs_results.description:
This program is designed for junior software engineers who wish to boost their careers by following an unconventional and particularly demanding growth path. Success will require, among other things, a "get things done" attitude, an exceptional sense of ownership, and a thorough understanding of fundamental engineering principles.

You may end up working in mobile development (Android, iOS), backend, cybersecurity and infrastructure, or AI engineering.

No formal work experience is required, making this an excellent opportunity for talented software engineers who are still in the early stages of their careers. As we expect participants to understand complex concepts and make meaningful contributions within a limited timeframe, a commitment to working ambitiously to exceed our standards is absolutely essential. We offer a salary of €105,737 along with a €1,200 welfare bonus.

A few examples of your responsibilities:
• Adopt a proactive attitude in tackling and solving exceptional... engineering challenges, contributing to product development and product roadmapping, and taking full ownership of the projects you work on.
• Learn about the latest technologies, testing the promising ones to make sure we don’t miss out on game-changing opportunities to boost our productivity and the quality of our work.
• Work with our other software engineers to constantly expand our set of libraries and relentlessly optimize our processes.
• Systematically improve the quality of our products, tools, or infrastructures by fixing bugs and refactoring the code base wherever necessary.

What we look for
• Indisputable excellence. Your academic or professional career is marked by a series of remarkable accomplishments. You have habitually achieved superior outcomes in your chosen fields and are continually seeking ways to outperform the expectations set for you.
• Logical-analytical abilities. You’re able to objectively evaluate complex information, arguments, and situations. You’re used to applying logical deduction to tackle sophisticated problems, and this has often allowed you to solve difficult intellectual challenges.
• Drive. Your dedication matches the intensity of your ambition. You’re willing to put in the hard work necessary to achieve your goals, and the highly demanding challenges in your track record are proof of your relentless spirit.
• Passion. You have a genuine love for the field. You investigate the subject extensively and are always up to date with the latest developments.
• Willingness to learn. We use Python for backend, and Swift and Kotlin for mobile. But it's not a problem if you have little or no experience with them, as long as you’re enthusiastic about learning. We’d be happy to teach you!
• Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
• Competitive salary and stock options. Our compensation packages are designed to attract and retain the best talent in the industry. Individuals just starting their career are offered a salary of €105,737 along with a €1,200 welfare bonus. Compensation can grow rapidly as the individual accumulates experience and translates it into greater and greater impact. You also have the option to receive some of your pay in company ownership (equity) at a discounted rate. Also, Italy grants individuals willing to relocate a 50% tax exemption on Italian-sourced income.
• An exceptional opportunity for growth. The majority of new Spooners didn’t expect to be trusted with so many responsibilities right from the start—and to be able to leverage them to explore the full extent of their potential. You’ll immediately start working in small, results-driven teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. You’ll see Spooners in their 20s leading businesses worth hundreds of millions. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects. We also do everything we can to offer a comprehensive spectrum of learning opportunities. Nothing but your drive, passion, and talent will determine how much and how fast you can grow.
• Unique engineering training. We pride ourselves on helping software engineers develop a well-rounded skillset: From time to time, you'll change projects and teams, broadening your skill set and helping keep things fresh. It’s a steep learning curve—we bet you can’t imagine how much you’ll have learned a year from now.
• All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, unrestricted remote working from European timezones, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a highly supportive relocation package, generous parental support, and yearly retreats to stunning locations. We encourage Spooners to use these benefits and many more to create the conditions to do their best work.

Commitment & contract

Fixed-term or internship. Full-time or part-time.

Location

Milan (Italy) or fully remote.

Before you apply

Thanks for taking the time to read this far. We’d be delighted if you decide to apply, but ask that you first consider the following:

Bending Spoons is an extremely demanding environment. We’re highly ambitious and we ask a lot of ourselves and our teammates, so you’re likely to work harder here than at most companies, and to regularly push yourself beyond your comfort zone. While this tends to drive tremendous learning and lead to fantastic achievements, it can also be stressful.

We’re uncompromising on our standard of excellence. The vast majority of Spooners stay for years and have amazing careers here. However, it can also happen that an individual doesn’t contribute at the rate we look for. In such cases, we support the Spooner in their efforts to make the necessary improvements, but will counsel them to leave if they don’t manage to do so.

We're proud of the company we've built, and many of us can't imagine working anywhere else. Still, we understand that a career at Bending Spoons isn't for everybody. We hope what you’ve read here helps you determine whether it might be the place for you. If you believe it is, then we encourage you to apply—and perhaps discover what you’re truly capable of!

The selection process

If you successfully pass through our screening process, we’ll invite you to take on a few tests that assess how you approach and solve unfamiliar problems. If you’re successful there, we’ll invite you to take part in some interviews. We welcome applications in English and Italian.

Bending Spoons is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We consider for employment all applicants and we provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, which can be requested at accommodations-ext@bendingspoons.com.

Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, we look for talent and potential—not just experience and expertise. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it, go ahead and apply

jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a Civil. Dpto Ofertas
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos Ingenieros/as Civiles para el Dpto. de Ofertas de la División de Transmisión e Infraestructuras de Coxabengoa, centrado en el negocio de subestaciones y líneas de transmisión.

Entre sus principales cometidos podemos destacar los siguientes:

- Estudio económico y técnico de las ofertas relativas a la obra civil de Subestaciones y Líneas de Transmisión.

- Análisis y revisión de proyectos.

- Elección y negociación con subcontratistas y proveedores.

- Coordinación con departamento de Ingeniería

jobs_results.description:
Mercury Mission Systems International Is Looking For a New Talent To Join Its Systems & Software Team In Getafe. We Are Looking For a

SENIOR EMBEDDED SOFTWARE ENGINEER

In cooperation with the Program Manager and the Software Manager, you will be supporting our software development and certification activities of complex high-performance safety and mission critical avionics and defense computers. You will be responsible for various software lead and development tasks.

Position Summary
• The Senior embedded softer engineer as member of the software design group, is responsible of the software high-level specification, architecture, and detailed design of the entire software items embedded into new avionics computer developed by MMSI.
• She/he takes parts to the project/ program life cycle as software functional leader managing all software activities.
• She/he is conducting all the technical analysis necessary to produce a design which meets customer and internal requirements... constraints in terms of functions, safety, performances, verification, industrialization, production, on-time, and on-cost.
• She/he is producing all the evidence and documentation in accordance with MMSI development process.
• She/he is conducting all the activities defined within MMSI integral process required by the product development life cycle (validation, configuration Management, checklists, problem reports, etc.)
• She/he is supporting the integration, validation, verification, and qualification activities as SW technical authority.
• She/is defining work package to be outsourced and following up suppliers.

Responsibilities
• Functional lead of software activities on highly complex avionic projects
• Establish and follow up software planning of the project.
• Coordinate with internal teams the different software activities of the project as well as the various milestones
• Ensure the software project execution is conform to the defined process.
• Participate to the specification, design, development, or verification activities when required.
• Develop and integrate software modules in C/C++, such as kernel drivers for Linux kernel, drivers for Certifiable RTOS (VxWorks 653, PikeOS, etc.), application software for system qualification or script for verification and testing tools.
• She/he participating to the transversal peer reviews as software expert.
• Software technical interface with customer or certification authorities
• The SW Functional leader has cross-functional skill, and capabilities to communicate with expert team, of other discipline (System, Hardware, FPGA, Safety)

Skills And Experience
• Master's degree in Information Technology electronics/computer science, or similar
• At least 7 years of industrial experience as embedded software engineer
• Fluent in Spanish and English
• Excellent programming skills in C/C++ and Python
• Proven background/experience in avionic safety critical software development life cycle (DO-178C)
• Proven background/experience in software project management (tasks definition, Workload evaluation, planning setup, tracking and monitoring, etc.)
• Technical knowledge/ experience in some of the following field is highly desired
• Certifiable RTOS and/or Linux kernel driver, as well as in application developments
• External stakeholder/ Outsourcing management
• Embedded Cyber-security (ED-203 / DO-356)
• Strong analytical ability.
• Ability to communicate effectively, both written and orally, with customers and at all organization levels.
• Leadership and ability to interact with multi-disciplined professionals to understand and make necessary trade-offs and decisions.
• High resilience and ability to work in a challenging and very dynamic environment

Why should you join Mercury Systems?

Mercury Systems is leading Commercial Provider of secure sensor and mission processing subsystems. We are pioneering a next generation defense electronics business model specifically designed to meet the current industry's current and emerging technology needs. The size and makeup of our organization enable forward thinking, entrepreneurial professionals thrive and prosper.

Mercury Mission Systems International SA (MMSI) Headquarters are, based in Geneva (CH), with branches in Getafe (SP), and Silchester (UK). MMSI is part of Mercury Systems, and is specialized in the design, manufacturing and maintenance of complex high-performance safety and mission critical avionics and defense computers.

Our Culture

We are committed to making Mercury a great place to work, no matter where our employees are located. We offer a casual and enjoyable atmosphere that allows employees to learn and grow. We help and care for one another and work as one to achieve results for us and for our customers. We value communication and transparency and strive to foster two-way dialogue at all levels of the organization. We are committed to lifelong learning, offering comprehensive skills training and tuition reimbursement. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey, or you are an experienced professional, it's important to us that you feel recognized and rewarded for your contributions.

Details
• Occupancy 100%
• Beginning of the activity ASAP
• Location Getafe (Madrid) Spain

We offer the opportunity to join a highly qualified and motivated team and the possibility to work in an international environment.

Why should you join Mercury Systems?

Mercury Systems is a technology company that makes the world a safer, more secure place. We push processing power to the tactical edge, making the latest commercial technologies profoundly more accessible for today's most challenging aerospace and defense missions. From silicon to system scale, Mercury enables customers to accelerate innovation and turn data into decision superiority. Headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, Mercury employs more than 2,300 people in 24 locations worldwide. To learn more, visit mrcy.com

Our Culture

We are committed to making Mercury a great place to work, no matter where our employees are located. We offer a casual and enjoyable atmosphere that allows employees to learn and grow. We help and care for one another and work as one to achieve results for us and for our customers. We value communication and transparency, and strive to foster two-way dialogue at all levels of the organization. We are committed to lifelong learning, offering comprehensive skills training and tuition reimbursement. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey or you are an experienced professional, it's important to us that you feel recognized and rewarded for your contributions.

To find out more about Why Mercury?, or visit the Mercury Community or find answers to general questions at Mercury FAQs

Mercury Systems is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, creed, citizenship, disability, protected veteran or marital status.

As an equal opportunity employer, Mercury Systems is committed to a diverse workforce. In order to ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veterans' Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact the number below.

(978) 256-1300
